protocol.attribution: Original protocol, batch tooling, sampling audit and aggregate implementation are AI assistance. Actual student responses and interpretations are recorded separately. Current execution will be assistant-operated, not an independently student-run study.
protocol.analysisPlan: Compare budgeted success out of 30 paired solvable maps per density/budget. Retain original success-conditioned means with explicit denominators; compare route length on common successes separately. Record rejected candidate seeds and counts. Within a density reuse maps across all budgets. Different-density cohorts can differ. Do not interpret 360 paired map/budget conditions as 360 independent maps.
protocol.knownPriorEvidence: Earlier single-map examples and one AI-run density-.19 budget-180 30-map reference were already inspected. This is the first full 12-condition reproduction of the existing reference protocol, not a blind new preregistration of previously unknown methods.

limitations: Only solvable maps are retained; rejected counts and seeds are recorded.
Within one density, both policies and every budget share the accepted maps.
Accepted cohorts can differ across densities; do not treat density comparisons as identical-map pairs.
Budgets reuse maps and are not independent samples. Density-specific cohorts use a common candidate seed stream.
Original path means condition on each policy succeeding; pairedSuccess uses only maps where both succeed.
Node expansions are not runtime, energy use, physical reliability or original algorithm invention.
